description: Event for recording live animal departure.

departureKind.description: Identifies the kind (method) of departure of the animal from the holding.

departureReason.description: Identifies the reason for the departure of the animal from the holding.

consignment.description: Identifies the consignment of the animal from the holding.

extendedReasons.description: Extended reason codes why this animal has departed.

diagnosisCode.description: Used with 'Health' reason to expand on health reasons for departure. Use ICAR (https://www.icar.org/guidelines/icar-central-health-key/) or VENOM coding scheme.
